claim: E3M1's four street zones (14 street sectors) differ by facade tile set more than by floor or light: the three ground zones share floor 4 and the boardwalk is 352, and every zone's floor has a median shade of +32/+34 with one sector of each at 8. 414 appears in every zone; the ground zones' leading facade tiles are {400,181,417,418}, {380,381,393} and {393,384,181}. city-norms.md reads the seams as falling at street junctions; the json does not hold that.
evidence: knowledge/blood/references/city-norms.json per_map E3M1 districts_art (tools/mine_city_norms.py): zones E3M1 s3,7,8,45 (floor 352), s4,5,65,175, s6,9,159 and s1,2,235 (floor 4); facade_wall_picnums_top5 and floor_shade per zone
use: In a Blood town, make a district a facade set plus a floor material under one night shade, after E3M1; light variety from sources rather than zone-wide shade bands is our reading, not counted.

checked.how: Opened knowledge/blood/references/city-norms.json per_map E3M1 districts_art: 4 zones of 4,4,3,3 street sectors; floors 352 (s3,7,8,45) and 4 (the other three); floor shade median 32 and 34,34,34, min 8; facade top5 {414}, {400,414,181,417,418}, {381,380,393,414}, {393,384,181,414,401}. Read the sectors with read_map: one at 8 in each zone (s8,5,9,1), the rest 32/34. Seams are not in the json, only in city-norms.md s6. One map: precedent, not tendency.
